_note: Compiled 2026-10-17 by the researcher. Every commonsFile and alt was confirmed to exist through the Wikimedia Commons API (imageinfo + extmetadata: author, licence, assessments). verified=true means a 360 px thumbnail was looked at and judged sharp, child-appropriate and matching the species and the card's lookFor; verified=false = only the Featured/Quality status and description were checked. Author names are the photographers' Commons credits (CC BY / CC BY-SA require attribution). Rule applied: no photo of a person holding or touching the animal, no dead animals, no food photos. fetch_photos.py re-reads author and licence from Commons extmetadata at download time and flags mismatches.
